plugins.name: concise-prose
plugins.description: Reshapes Claude Code output for fast human reading: conclusion first, only reasoning that carries information, and an enforced standalone SUMMARY (plus OPEN ITEMS when needed) at the end of every response via a Stop hook.

plugins.name: agent-sandbox-provision
plugins.description: Provisions a read-only AWS+Kubernetes+GitHub+MongoDB+Snowflake sandbox for Claude Code, sweeps it for plaintext credentials reachable from the sandbox identity, and deletes it when done.
